job.job_description:
Role & responsibilities

AI Solution Design & Architecture

Design end-to-end AI/GenAI architectures and technical solutions.
Build scalable and secure AI platforms leveraging LLMs and Agentic AI frameworks.
Create High-Level Design (HLD) and Low-Level Design (LLD) documents for AI applications.
Define AI governance, security, and responsible AI best practices.

Generative AI Development

Develop and deploy applications using Large Language Models (LLMs).
Design and implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions.
Fine-tune, optimize, and evaluate foundation models for business use cases.
Build AI-powered chatbots, virtual assistants, knowledge management, and automation solutions.
Develop prompt engineering strategies and model evaluation frameworks.

Agentic AI & Multi-Agent Systems

Design and implement autonomous AI agents and multi-agent workflows.
Build agent orchestration, tool integration, memory management, and reasoning capabilities.
Develop intelligent systems capable of planning, decision-making, and task automation.
Integrate AI agents with enterprise applications, APIs, and data sources.

Development & Integration

Develop AI applications using Python and modern AI frameworks.
Build APIs and microservices for AI model deployment and integration.
Implement scalable AI pipelines and production-grade MLOps processes.
Optimize model performance, latency, and cost efficiency.



Required Skills

Programming: Python, SQL
Generative AI: LLMs, Prompt Engineering, RAG, Fine-Tuning
Agentic AI: AI Agents, Multi-Agent Systems, Tool Calling, Agent Orchestration
Frameworks: LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, AutoGen
AI Models: OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Open Source LLMs
Machine Learning: NLP, Deep Learning, Model Evaluation
Cloud: AWS, Azure, or GCP AI Services
MLOps: Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, Model Deployment
Databases: Vector Databases (Pinecone, Chroma, Weaviate, FAISS), SQL/NoSQL
APIs & Integration: REST APIs, Microservices

Preferred candidate profile
